The CUMULATIVE 39,405.39 (= 26,231.39 last + 13,174.00) is larger and its prior-period money is not itemized on this document. Six rows are filer-tagged in-kind (6,682.00 of the 13,174.00) and all six count toward the printed total.

itemized.notes: 2026-cycle filing on the county's NEW 'Campaign Financial Summary' form, scanned by the filer with CamScanner (the app watermark is printed on every page). SIX pages and a structure this brief's page-order warning is worth restating for: p1 = the cover (handwritten candidate block and 3-line summary), p2 = a TYPED restatement of the same summary, p3-p4 = the Itemized Contribution Report over two continuation sheets, p5-p6 = the Itemized Expenditures Report over two continuation sheets. NO per-sheet subtotals anywhere: each schedule prints one grand TOTAL on its last sheet, so both sides were gated on the multi-sheet sum. The schedules are typed spreadsheet prints; only the cover is handwritten. NO REPORT-TYPE BOX IS MARKED - this form prints its Filing Schedule as a bare list with the checkboxes lost in the scan/flatten, so the honest reading is 'no box marked' (the signature is dated 23 May 2026, which sits with the 'May 26 - Pre-Primary Election' deadline, but nothing on the document says so and nothing was inferred). The county REDACTED the street address, city/zip and home phone on the cover; the cell phone is printed in the clear. The Item column carries the donor/payee name on one line and city/state on the next; contributor STREET addresses are not printed on this form at all, so donor_city/donor_state are complete as filed. In-kind items are tagged by the filer in an unheaded column right of Amount and DO count toward the printed totals; one contribution row is tagged 'loan' (a 500.00 self-loan) and is likewise inside the total.
